name: eap-ade-invoke-backend
description: Always-on streaming invoke backend for the Agent Deployment Engineer (ADE) console chat (ADR-040). Runs on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. SigV4-signs AgentCore InvokeAgentRuntime with A2A message/stream so the ADE turn streams token-by-token, while enforcing Cognito/OIDC JWT auth and the Requirement-11 runtime allow-list that the invoke-proxy Lambda provided.
author: Vikrant Dhir <vikdhir@amazon.com>
